|description = {{Description|decoration}} |showheader = n |size = 64 }} The '''Fancy House Plant''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. There a number of varieties of Fancy House Plant, which are named in the game's UI as either "Fancy House Plants" or "House Plants", as shown below. ==Fancy House Plants== "Fancy House Plants" can be obtained from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]] in the [[Mayor's Manor]] and are available in 3 varieties. Although it is called "Fancy House Plant" in the game's UI, it is also referred to as "Fancy Tree" in the game's code. {|class="wikitable" style="margin-left: 4px;" |- !colspan="3"|Version 1 |- !1 !2 !3 |- |[[File:Fancy House Plant.png|64px]] |[[File:Fancy House Plant 2.png|64px]] |[[File:Fancy House Plant 3.png|64px]] |- |} ==House Plants== "House Plants" can be obtained from differing locations depending on which of the 5 varieties [[the Player]] is trying to acquire. The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd "House Plant" varieties can be obtained from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]] in the [[Mayor's Manor]], while the 4th and 5th "House Plant" varieties can be obtained from the [[Movie Theater#Crane Game|Crane Game]] in the [[Movie Theater]].
